About Barberous.

Barberous is a men’s barbershop in Hadat, Baabda District, Mount Lebanon — just minutes from Beirut. Founded by Elie Chehade, we offer classic and modern haircuts, beard grooming, face care, hair coloring, keratin treatments, and waxing services. All prices are listed in USD. Walk-ins are welcome, or you can request an appointment by WhatsApp. We’re open Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM, and closed on Sundays.

Good to know.

Quick answers about visiting the shop, prices and booking.

Where is Barberous located?

Barberous is a barbershop in Hadat, Baabda District, Mount Lebanon, Lebanon — a few minutes from Beirut. Open in Google Maps for directions.

What are the opening hours?

Monday to Saturday from 10 AM to 8 PM. Sunday we are closed.

How much is a haircut?

A haircut is $13. Hair and beard together is $20, a beard trim is $7 and a junior haircut is $10. All prices are in USD.

Do I need an appointment?

Walk-ins are welcome. For a specific time, send a WhatsApp message to +961 70 576 915 with your service and preferred day and time. The shop confirms manually.

Which services do you offer?

Haircut, hair and beard, beard trim, junior haircut, hair styling, basic hair color, keratin treatment, beard color, face mask, eyebrow shaping, nose and ear waxing, and a $30 grooming package with haircut, beard, nails and face mask.

Do you cut children’s hair?

Yes. A junior haircut is $10.

How do I book an appointment?

Tap any service row or the WhatsApp button on this page. WhatsApp opens with a prefilled request; add your preferred day and time, then send it. Barberous confirms on WhatsApp.

Which areas does Barberous serve?

Barberous serves Hadat, Baabda District, Mount Lebanon, and nearby Beirut neighborhoods. We’re minutes from central Beirut.

Do you accept walk-ins without an appointment?

Yes. Walk-ins are welcome at our Hadat shop Monday to Saturday, 10 AM to 8 PM. For a specific time, it’s best to message us on WhatsApp first.

Can I request a specific barber?

Yes. When you message us on WhatsApp, let us know if you’d prefer Elie or Mohamad, and we’ll do our best to accommodate.
